sourceArticle.title: Anthropic's Claude Code Artifacts update brings live, shared dashboards and interactive workspaces to enterprises
sourceArticle.author: Carl Franzen

athenaOutput.directive: Establish the Sovereign Artifact Runtime (SAR) as the definitive self-hosted, multi-agent sandbox for enterprise decision-making, ensuring that collaborative workspaces are fully owned, instantly compiled, and cryptographically verified without reliance on external proprietary clouds.
athenaOutput.rationale: Anthropic's shift into live, shared dashboards and interactive workspaces highlights a massive enterprise demand for collaborative, AI-generated interfaces. However, relying on third-party hosted runtimes directly violates Article I (Sovereignty) and exposes sensitive enterprise logic. The Creative Liberation Engine must pioneer a completely self-hosted, local-first alternative that compiles fully-fledged production-grade systems (Article IX) rather than ephemeral mock dashboards, orchestrated autonomously to eliminate human latency (Article XX).

options.title: Sovereign Artifact Runtime (SAR)
options.description: A local-first, containerized, and secure runtime environment that compiles and renders live, interactive enterprise dashboards within the organization's own sovereign cloud infrastructure.
options.tradeoffs: Requires robust sandboxing and container orchestration to prevent rogue code execution, increasing initial infrastructure setup complexity.

options.title: Autonomous Swarm Workspace (ASW)
options.description: An interactive dashboard environment that is continuously constructed, updated, and optimized by a collaborative swarm of agents (BOLT, AURORA, VERA) responding to real-time telemetry, requiring zero human manual updates.
options.tradeoffs: High continuous computational overhead and complex multi-agent state synchronization challenges.

options.title: Cryptographically Verified Artifact Network (CVAN)
options.description: A decentralized, zero-trust workspace where every code generation, data query, and dashboard state mutation is cryptographically signed and verified by VERA and LEX.
options.tradeoffs: Introduces minor execution latency due to cryptographic verification overhead, though it guarantees absolute compliance and security.

options.title: Neuro-Existential State Mapping (NESM)
options.description: An advanced visualization interface that maps enterprise operations as a living neural network, where interactive artifacts represent synaptic nodes reflecting organizational health and decision-making pathways.
options.tradeoffs: Extremely high conceptual complexity and requires deep integration into heterogeneous enterprise data sources.

options.title: Ephemeral Prototyping Sandbox (EPS)
options.description: A lightweight, browser-only sandbox that mimics Claude's Artifacts on the client side without deep backend system integration or persistent storage.
options.tradeoffs: Directly violates Article IX (No MVPs) by providing non-persistent, incomplete software prototypes rather than robust production systems.

constitutionalFlags: Article IX: Ship Complete or Don't Ship
Article XX: Zero human wait time
